social.heading: Quiet notes, as we begin.
featuredAlts: We Prepare — we spend a lifetime getting ready
We Prepare — sometimes, long before the moment arrives
We Prepare — we imagine, we choose, we make things ready
We Prepare — we even prepare for things we hope we will never need
We Prepare — preparation has always been another way of saying I care
We Prepare — one journey we rarely prepare for
stripAlts: A thousand unnamed hopes gathered around one life
Before we became children, friends, partners, parents
Before we became all the people life would ask us to be
We leave the world exactly as we entered it
We prepare, long before they arrive
The first day stays with us

brand.statement: Standing beside families through the last goodbye — carrying the weight, so you can simply be with the one you love.
